_README: EXAMPLE runtime config for a coding-agent CLI (e.g. .claude/settings.json). This is a SKELETON:
copy it to your runtime's settings path, replace every ${WORKSPACE} with your absolute repo root,
and point each hook command at the real gate script. JSON has no comments, so guidance lives here.
The hooks below wire the security gates described in CLAUDE.md and docs/security-gates.md:
SessionStart     -> load the session-bootstrap parachute + run idempotent boot tasks
UserPromptSubmit -> reset the auto-compound counter on each new operator message
UserPromptSubmit -> surface new fleet-bus messages addressed to the hub (bus_turn_poll.py)
PreToolUse       -> stand-down registry check before installs / MCP adds / settings edits
PreToolUse       -> lint skill files for injection patterns before they are trusted
PostToolUse      -> verify-after-write on file edits (re-read the written value)
Stop             -> reply-guard / save-nudge at end of turn
Replace the matcher tool names with your runtime's actual tool identifiers.
permissions.deny encodes the BLOCKED class: secrets are never readable, outbound-send is never run,
and curl-pipe-bash is refused. Tighten allow[] to the tools you actually want auto-approved.
